name: manage_script
description: Register, unregister or list user scripts as tools. register takes a script path anywhere on disk, copies it into the scripts directory and makes it a tool from the next round; the tool description, parameters, timeout and group are read from the script header (# Description:, # Parameters:, # Timeout:, # Group:) unless overridden here. unregister hides a script or deletes its file. list shows registered, unregistered and disabled scripts with their directories.

action.description: register adds or updates (fields not given are kept), unregister hides or deletes, list shows everything.

id.description: Tool name. Required for unregister. For register it defaults to the header `# Id:` line, else the file name with non-alphanumerics folded to `_`.

path.description: register: absolute path of the script anywhere on disk (copied into the scripts directory), or a file name already inside it. Omit to update an existing entry by id.

scope.description: register: where a copied script lands. persona (default) is visible only to the current persona; global to all.

display_name.description: Human-readable name; may contain Chinese. Defaults to the header `# Display name:` line.

description.description: Override for the header `# Description:` line. Required only when the header has none.

parameters.description: JSON Schema override for the header `# Parameters:` block. Without either, the tool takes free-form arguments passed as JSON on stdin.

timeout_seconds.description: Override for the header `# Timeout:` line. Default 120, max 300.

overwrite.description: register: replace a file of the same name already in the scripts directory.

delete_file.description: unregister: also delete the script file. Built-in scripts can only be hidden.
